description: Retirement income gap for one of 35 countries (nl, se, dk, no, fi, is, cz, at, ch, pt, us, cn, de, jp, in, fr, it, ca, br, ru, kr, mx, es, id, tr, sa, pl, be, ar, ie, ae, sg, il, th, nz): from accessible savings, monthly saving, retirement spending and up to three pension streams the user enters (after tax, in today's money), the savings at retirement, the capital needed, the capital gap, the first-year monthly gap and the age the money runs out. It does not calculate national pension entitlements. All fields are required; amounts in the country's currency (see list_retirement_calculators), rates in percent per year; use monthly 0 for unused pension streams.

balance.description: Accessible savings in country currency; exclude capital behind entered pension payments

country.description: Country code from list_retirement_calculators (not uk or au, which have their own tools).

endAge.description: Projection end age; must exceed retirement age; whole years.

include_projection.description: Also return annual cash-flow rows (default false: a compact summary).

incomes.description: Exactly three user-supplied pension streams. Use zero monthly amount for unused streams. No entitlement or tax estimation.

endAge.description: Exclusive payment stop age; use 0 for no stop, otherwise greater than startAge; whole years.

monthly.description: After-tax monthly income in today's country currency

monthlySaving.description: Monthly savings in today's country currency

netReturn.description: Nominal annual return after taxes and fees, percent; inflation is deducted by the model

retirementAge.description: Work-stop age; at least current age; not an entitlement age; whole years.

spending.description: Monthly retirement spending in today's country currency

name: calculate_retirement_income_gap
title: Retirement income gap
